virality_data.analysis: Multi-agent LLM systems for financial analysis and automated research are surging on GitHub with frameworks like TradingAgents and ByteDance's deer-flow hitting top trends. Most tutorials remain surface-level theoretical overviews without showing how disparate agents parse unstructured documents and reconcile conflicting analyst signals. This article gives developers a functional 3-agent pipeline using MarkItDown to ingest 10-K filings and generate consensus summaries.
